note: Human decisions on case-law watcher records (stocks/watch-caselaw.mjs), keyed by sonar.litigation_case.id (`courtlistener-r:<docket id>`, `courtlistener-o:<cluster id>`, `sec-lr:<release no.>`, `sec-ap:<release no.>`). `dismissed`: recorded, but raises no further events (unrelated to the tokenized structure). `confirmed`: judged relevant; its docket is always followed for new entries. Neither ever sets a what-if answer to `litigated` — that takes a dossier edit citing the decision. Every decision needs a reason; reviewedAt is when the human decided.

decisions.caseName: Fox v. Ally Financial Inc.
decisions.reason: January 2021 meme-stock trading-restriction suit naming Alpaca Securities LLC; transferred into MDL 2989 (S.D. Fla.), where Alpaca was voluntarily dismissed without prejudice from the Antitrust Tranche (ECF No. 398, 2021-08-24) and not named in the Other Broker Tranche complaint (ECF No. 410) — no decision about Alpaca exists. The nearest holding (Juncadella v. Robinhood, 76 F.4th 1335 (11th Cir. 2023): a broker whose customer agreement reserved discretion to restrict trading owed its own customers no duty to take their orders) concerns direct U.S. brokerage customers, not holders of an issuer's tracker notes with no contract with Alpaca. Recorded as related-not-on-point in xstocks-backed and ondo-global-markets whatIf[venue-delists].
